submissions.explanation: A direct proof of the eta0 primorial-sieve transfer. The proof truncates the sum using the exact support of eta0, bounds eta0 by 3, and identifies every removed non-coprime von Mangoldt term with a prime or prime power supported on the primorial. Prime terms are bounded by Chebyshev theta at sqrt(y), composite prime powers by psi(y)-theta(y), and Mathlib's explicit Chebyshev estimates plus x >= 8.7e36 yield the stated 9e-8 relative error. No imported source theorem, sorry, or custom axiom is used.
